notes: pop_jump_if_falsy pops the false condition and jumps past the second store, so x keeps its first-assigned value (docs/isa.md section 5, ADR-0013)
pop_jump_if_falsy pops a true condition and falls through, so the second store overwrites x - the mirror of pop-jump-if-falsy-taken
an unbound variable's load pushes :undefined, and pop_jump_if_falsy treats :undefined as falsy exactly as jump_if_falsy_or_pop does (docs/isa.md section 5)
a non-boolean condition is a TypeMismatchError naming pop_jump_if_falsy and boolean, never a coercion (docs/isa.md section 5)
ADR-0013's full if/else lowering with a true condition: pop_jump_if_falsy falls through into the if-branch, which ends with an unconditional jump past the else-branch
the same if/else lowering with a false condition: pop_jump_if_falsy jumps directly to the else-branch's first instruction, past both the if-branch and its trailing jump

the full if/else lowering (condition, pop_jump_if_falsy, if-branch, trailing jump, else-branch) with a non-boolean condition: pop_jump_if_falsy raises TypeMismatchError before either branch or the jump ever runs, unlike pop-jump-if-falsy-non-boolean above which has no else-branch or jump to skip (docs/isa.md section 5)

ADR-0013's else-if desugaring (else-if is sugar for an else block whose sole statement is a nested if): c1 true takes the first branch, and its trailing jump skips both the c2 check and every later branch, landing directly on the final load

the same else-if chain with c1 false and c2 true: the first pop_jump_if_falsy lands on c2's instruction (the desugared nested if's own condition), which then takes its own if-branch - the mirror of else-if-chain-first-branch
the same else-if chain with both c1 and c2 false: both pop_jump_if_falsy instructions take their jump, falling through to the desugared nested if's own else-branch - the chain's final else

a nested if/else inside the outer if-branch: the outer pop_jump_if_falsy's offset (11) spans the whole inner if/else lowering, and with both conditions true, execution runs the inner if-branch, then the inner jump, then the outer jump, landing on the final load

the same nesting with the outer condition true and the inner condition false: the outer branch is entered, and its inner pop_jump_if_falsy takes the inner else-branch instead - the mirror of nested-if-then-branch-inner-if
a false outer condition jumps straight over the entire nested if/else (both its branches and its own condition check) to the outer else-branch, without ever evaluating the inner condition

an empty then-block with no else lowers to c; pop_jump_if_falsy 1 with zero instructions between the jump and its target - a true condition pops and falls through directly into the following instruction, same as a false condition would (see if-empty-then-block-condition-false)

the mirror of if-empty-then-block-condition-true: a false condition takes the jump, landing on the same following instruction the true condition falls through to - an empty block makes both branches converge on the same target

an empty else-block lowers the trailing jump to offset 1 (zero instructions between it and its target): a true condition runs the if-branch, then the jump immediately lands on the instruction after the empty else-block

the mirror of if-else-empty-else-block-condition-true: a false condition jumps straight past the if-branch and its trailing jump to the empty else-block, which runs nothing, so x is observed unchanged from the context
